title: Odesa National Maritime University
summary: Odesa National Maritime University is a public institution located in Odesa, Ukraine, specializing in maritime education. Established in 1930, it has educated students from more than 90 countries in fields pertinent to the maritime industry.

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: Odesa National Maritime University, known in [[ukrainian|Ukrainian]] as Одеський національний морський університет, is situated in [[odesa|Odesa, Ukraine]].

sections.heading: History
paragraphs: The university was founded in 1930, marking its long-standing presence in the realm of maritime education.

sections.heading: International Reach
paragraphs: The institution has trained students from over 90 countries, reflecting its global engagement and the importance of maritime studies in an international context.
